extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於餐飲、活動與圖片題情境，如 feel hungry。也可以用 hungry for 表示「渴望」某樣東西，如成功或新挑戰。

example.en: Customers get hungrier after noon, so we open the kitchen early.
example.zh: 顧客中午過後會更餓，所以我們提早開放廚房。

example.en: Lunchtime is when our customers are at their hungriest.
example.zh: 午餐時間是我們的顧客最餓的時候。

example.en: I always feel hungry before the lunch break starts.
example.zh: 午休開始前我總是覺得很餓。

example.en: No guest should go hungry at our charity dinner.
example.zh: 在我們的慈善晚宴上，不該有任何賓客挨餓。

example.en: Our young team is hungry for new challenges.
example.zh: 我們年輕的團隊渴望新的挑戰。

examples.en: Many customers arrive hungry after a long day at work.
examples.zh: 許多顧客在工作一整天後餓著肚子到來。

examples.en: Let's order lunch because everyone is getting hungry.
examples.zh: 我們來訂午餐吧，因為大家都餓了。

examples.en: The staff were hungry after the long training session.
examples.zh: 在漫長的訓練課程後，員工都餓了。

confusable.diff: 字尾 -ngry 相同，容易看錯；angry 是「生氣的」，hungry 是「餓的」。

example.en: The manager was angry about the late delivery.
example.zh: 經理對延遲送貨感到生氣。

similar.diff: starving 比 hungry 更口語、更強烈，意思是「餓壞了」。

example.en: I'm starving, so let's have lunch now.
example.zh: 我餓壞了，我們現在去吃午餐吧。

example.en: Visitors are often thirsty after the long tour.
example.zh: 長時間參觀後，訪客常常覺得口渴。

example.en: I'm full, so I will skip dessert.
example.zh: 我吃飽了，所以甜點就不吃了。

example.en: The ticket price includes a free meal on the train.
example.zh: 票價包含火車上的一份免費餐點。

derived.link: 最基本的字；hunger + -y，有…的，像 thirst → thirsty
hungry 去掉 y 加 -ily，變副詞，像 happy → happily

extra_vocab.en: a large main road between cities
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於交通、物流與位置說明，如 near the highway。美式 highway 泛指連接城市的主要幹道，不一定是收費的高速公路。

example.en: New highways have shortened the trip between the two cities.
example.zh: 新的公路縮短了兩座城市之間的車程。

example.en: Take the second highway exit after the bridge.
example.zh: 過橋後請從第二個高速公路出口下去。

example.en: Highway construction will cause delays until the end of May.
example.zh: 公路施工會造成延誤，直到五月底。

example.en: The highway toll is included in the delivery cost.
example.zh: 公路通行費已包含在運費內。

examples.en: The office is located near the main highway.
examples.zh: 辦公室位在主要公路附近。

examples.en: Trucks use the highway to deliver goods to the port.
examples.zh: 貨車走公路把貨物送到港口。

examples.en: Traffic is heavy on the highway during rush hour.
examples.zh: 尖峰時段公路上交通很繁忙。

similar.diff: freeway 是美式說法，指不收費、多線道的快速道路；highway 範圍較廣。

example.en: The freeway is closed because of an accident.
example.zh: 因為一起事故，快速道路封閉了。

similar.diff: expressway 強調車速快、出入口受限制的快速道路。

example.en: Take the expressway to reach the airport faster.
example.zh: 走快速道路可以更快到達機場。

example.en: The road to the factory is closed today.
example.zh: 通往工廠的道路今天封閉。

example.en: Heavy traffic made me late for the meeting.
example.zh: 嚴重的塞車讓我開會遲到。

example.en: You must pay a toll to use this bridge.
example.zh: 使用這座橋必須支付通行費。

extra_vocab.en: to have the main office of a company in a place
extra_vocab.note: 多益最常見的是名詞 headquarters（總部）和被動說法 be headquartered in + 地點。單數名詞 headquarter 和主動動詞用法都很少見。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: headquarters 當「總部」時字尾的 s 不去掉，單複數同形；動詞多用被動：be headquartered in + 地點。

example.en: All the headquarters of the large banks are in this district.
example.zh: 各大銀行的總部都在這個地區。

example.en: The firm headquartered its new division in Osaka last year.
example.zh: 這家公司去年把新部門的總部設在大阪。

example.en: Headquartering the company in Taipei reduced our travel costs.
example.zh: 把公司總部設在台北降低了我們的差旅費。

example.en: The company is headquartered in Singapore and has offices abroad.
example.zh: 這家公司總部設在新加坡，在國外也有辦公室。

example.en: Please send the contract to our corporate headquarters.
example.zh: 請把合約寄到我們的公司總部。

example.en: We plan to move our headquarters to a larger building.
example.zh: 我們打算把總部搬到更大的大樓。

examples.en: The firm's headquarters is in Chicago, and it has fifty branches.
examples.zh: 這家公司的總部在芝加哥，並有五十家分公司。

examples.en: Please call our headquarters if you have any questions.
examples.zh: 如果有任何問題，請致電我們的總部。

examples.en: The airline is headquartered near the international airport.
examples.zh: 這家航空公司的總部設在國際機場附近。

similar.diff: head office 是英式常用說法，較口語；headquarters 較正式，也可指軍隊或警察總部。

example.en: The head office will announce the new policy soon.
example.zh: 總公司很快會公布新的政策。

example.en: We opened a new branch in Kaohsiung last month.
example.zh: 我們上個月在高雄開了一家新分公司。

example.en: Our office is on the fifth floor.
example.zh: 我們的辦公室在五樓。

example.en: The company will headquarter its Asian team in Tokyo.
example.zh: 公司將把亞洲團隊的總部設在東京。

example.en: The annual meeting will take place at our headquarters.
example.zh: 年度會議將在我們的總部舉行。

extra_vocab.en: a sudden rise in price, or a long walk in nature
extra_vocab.note: 多益新聞與公告中常見 price hike、rent hike（漲價、租金上漲）。休閒與旅遊情境裡，hike 也指健行、徒步旅行。

example.en: Several hikes are planned for the team-building weekend.
example.zh: 團隊建立的週末安排了好幾次健行。

example.en: The company hiked its prices by ten percent last month.
example.zh: 公司上個月把價格調漲了百分之十。

example.en: Hiking in the mountains is a popular weekend activity here.
example.zh: 在山裡健行是這裡很受歡迎的週末活動。

example.en: A price hike will take effect at the start of June.
example.zh: 漲價將在六月初生效。

example.en: The landlord announced a rent hike for next January.
example.zh: 房東宣布明年一月要調漲租金。

example.en: Staff can go on a hike in the nearby mountains on Saturday.
example.zh: 員工星期六可以去附近的山上健行。

examples.en: Customers complained about the sudden hike in ticket prices.
examples.zh: 顧客抱怨票價突然上漲。

examples.en: Our company organizes a group hike every spring.
examples.zh: 我們公司每年春天都會舉辦團體健行。

examples.en: The central bank may hike rates to control rising prices.
examples.zh: 中央銀行可能調升利率來控制物價上漲。

similar.diff: increase 較中性正式；hike 較口語、多見於新聞，常指突然或大幅的上漲。

example.en: We plan to increase prices next quarter.
example.zh: 我們計畫下一季調漲價格。

example.en: There was a sharp increase in fuel costs.
example.zh: 燃料成本大幅增加。

example.en: A rise in rent made many shops close.
example.zh: 租金上漲讓許多商店歇業。

example.en: The trail starts behind the visitor center.
example.zh: 這條步道從遊客中心後方開始。

example.en: The bank decided to hike interest rates again next month.
example.zh: 銀行決定下個月再次調升利率。

example.en: The team enjoyed a short hike after the workshop.
example.zh: 團隊在工作坊結束後享受了一小段健行。

senses.en: a sudden rise in the price or amount of something
senses.distinguish: 旁邊有 price、rent、tax、rate 等字時，指上漲，不是健行。

example.en: A sudden hike in fuel prices hurt our delivery business.
example.zh: 燃料價格突然上漲，打擊了我們的配送業務。

extra_vocab.en: work that a teacher gives students to do at home
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於學校、培訓與對話情境。商務上常用 do your homework，意思是「事前做好功課、先做好調查」。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: homework 是不可數名詞，不加 s、不說 a homework；要用 a piece of homework 或 an assignment。

example.en: The students do homework in the library every afternoon.
example.zh: 學生們每天下午都在圖書館寫作業。

example.en: The teacher gave a long homework assignment on Monday.
example.zh: 老師星期一出了一份很長的作業。

example.en: Always do your homework before you start a negotiation.
example.zh: 開始談判之前，一定要先做好功課。

examples.en: Students must finish their homework before the class starts.
examples.zh: 學生必須在上課前完成作業。

examples.en: Employees receive homework after each online training session.
examples.zh: 員工在每次線上訓練後都會收到作業。

examples.en: Homework is due on Friday, so please plan your time.
examples.zh: 作業星期五要交，所以請安排好時間。

confusable.diff: 拼法相近；housework 是做家事（打掃、洗衣），homework 是作業。

example.en: She shares the housework with her roommate every weekend.
example.zh: 她每個週末和室友分擔家事。

similar.diff: assignment 是可數名詞，指一項作業或任務；homework 是不可數名詞。

example.en: Each student has an assignment due on Friday.
example.zh: 每位學生都有一份星期五要交的作業。

example.en: The first lesson starts at nine in the morning.
example.zh: 第一堂課早上九點開始。

example.en: The final exam will be held next Tuesday.
example.zh: 期末考試將在下週二舉行。

extra_vocab.en: a person whose job is to clean and take care of a hotel or a home
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於飯店與住宿情境，指負責打掃客房的房務人員。也可指受雇管理家務的人。

example.en: The hotel trains its housekeepers to follow safety rules.
example.zh: 這家飯店訓練房務人員遵守安全規定。

example.en: A hotel housekeeper found the lost wallet under the bed.
example.zh: 一位飯店房務員在床下找到了遺失的皮夾。

example.en: The couple decided to hire a housekeeper to help with the house.
example.zh: 這對夫妻決定僱一位幫手來打理家務。

example.en: The head housekeeper checks the rooms before guests arrive.
example.zh: 房務主管會在客人抵達前檢查房間。

examples.en: The housekeeper cleans every guest room before noon each day.
examples.zh: 房務員每天中午前會打掃每一間客房。

examples.en: Please tell the housekeeper if you need extra towels.
examples.zh: 如果需要多的毛巾，請告訴房務員。

examples.en: They hired a housekeeper to manage their large home.
examples.zh: 他們僱了一位管家來打理他們的大房子。

similar.diff: maid 較舊式，常指打掃的女性；housekeeper 更中性，也可指負責管理的人。

example.en: A maid cleaned the room while we were out.
example.zh: 我們外出時，有位清潔人員打掃了房間。

similar.diff: cleaner 指一般清潔人員，不限於飯店或住家。

example.en: The cleaner comes every evening to clean the offices.
example.zh: 清潔人員每天傍晚來打掃辦公室。

example.en: Each guest receives a free bottle of water.
example.zh: 每位房客都會收到一瓶免費的水。

example.en: Please leave the used towel on the floor.
example.zh: 請把用過的毛巾放在地上。

example.en: The hotel offers a same-day laundry service.
example.zh: 這家飯店提供當日取件的洗衣服務。

derived.link: housekeeper 的詞幹 housekeep + -ing，變成名詞，像 meeting、parking

extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於薪資、收費與時刻表情境，如 hourly wage、hourly rate。可放在名詞前當形容詞，也可放在動詞後當副詞。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: hourly 字尾雖是 -ly，但可當形容詞（an hourly rate）也可當副詞（paid hourly）。

example.en: Our lawyer's hourly rate is higher than we expected.
example.zh: 我們律師的每小時費率比我們預期的高。

example.en: The company raised the hourly wage for new staff.
example.zh: 公司調高了新進員工的時薪。

example.en: Temporary workers are paid on an hourly basis.
example.zh: 臨時工是按小時計酬。

examples.en: Hourly buses run between the airport and the hotel.
examples.zh: 每小時一班的巴士往返機場與飯店。

examples.en: The consultant charges an hourly fee for each meeting.
examples.zh: 顧問每場會議按小時收費。

examples.en: The system saves the data hourly to protect all files.
examples.zh: 系統每小時儲存一次資料，以保護所有檔案。

similar.diff: per hour 是片語，放在金額或數量後面；hourly 是單字，可放在名詞前。

example.en: The workers earn fifteen dollars per hour.
example.zh: 工人每小時賺十五美元。

example.en: Please send me a daily report by five.
example.zh: 請在五點前寄給我每日報告。

example.en: We hold a weekly meeting on Monday mornings.
example.zh: 我們每週一早上開週會。

example.en: The monthly fee includes internet and phone service.
example.zh: 月費包含網路和電話服務。

derived.link: 最基本的字；hour + -ly，每…的，像 daily、weekly、monthly

example.en: Hourly updates will be posted on the company website.
example.zh: 每小時的更新會張貼在公司網站上。

example.en: Most of the temporary staff are paid hourly, not monthly.
example.zh: 大部分臨時員工是按小時計酬，不是按月。

extra_vocab.en: the machines and parts of a computer, or tools made of metal
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於 IT 與採購情境，指電腦的實體設備，和 software 相對。在店面情境中，hardware store 指五金行。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: hardware 是不可數名詞，不加 s，不說 a hardware；要計算時用 a piece of hardware。

example.en: The company sells computer hardware to schools and offices.
example.zh: 這家公司把電腦硬體賣給學校和辦公室。

example.en: There is a hardware store next to the post office.
example.zh: 郵局旁邊有一家五金行。

example.en: Both hardware and software must be updated each year.
example.zh: 硬體和軟體每年都必須更新。

examples.en: We need to upgrade our hardware before installing the new system.
examples.zh: 安裝新系統之前，我們需要先升級硬體。

examples.en: The hardware costs more than the software license.
examples.zh: 硬體的費用比軟體授權費高。

examples.en: The technician found a problem with the hardware, not the program.
examples.zh: 技師發現問題出在硬體，而不是程式。

confusable.diff: 意思相反：hardware 是看得到、摸得到的設備；software 是電腦裡的程式。

example.en: The new software runs faster on the updated computer.
example.zh: 新的軟體在更新後的電腦上跑得更快。

similar.diff: equipment 泛指各種設備；hardware 特指電腦硬體或五金用品。

example.en: The factory bought new equipment for packing.
example.zh: 工廠買了新的包裝設備。

example.en: Please charge your device before the meeting.
example.zh: 開會前請先替你的裝置充電。

example.en: All office equipment must be checked every year.
example.zh: 所有辦公設備每年都必須檢查。

example.en: This tool makes the repair work much easier.
example.zh: 這個工具讓維修工作容易許多。

senses.en: the machines and parts of a computer system
senses.distinguish: 旁邊有 software、computer、upgrade、system 等字時，指電腦硬體。

example.en: The hardware in our office is more than five years old.
example.zh: 我們辦公室的硬體已經用了五年以上。

senses.en: tools and small metal things used at home or at work
senses.distinguish: 旁邊有 store、shop、tools、nails 等字時，指五金用品。

example.en: The shop sells paint, tools, and other hardware for repairs.
example.zh: 這家店販售油漆、工具和其他維修用的五金。
